name: Iterative Volume Refinement
definition: An iterative algorithm to refine the shape of the volume by removing scattering voxels and smoothing sharp corners to increase coding gain. It compares reconstructed views against original reference images to identify and correct geometry errors.
summary: Iterative Volume Refinement cleans sparse voxel clouds by dynamically removing scattering voxels and smoothing corners based on error thresholds and smooth surface assumptions.
